content: अनुपपत्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Failure, failing to be; लक्षणा शक्यसंबन्धस्तात्पर्यानुपपत्तितः <ls>Bhāṣā P. 82</ls> (तात्पर्य˚ being the failure of the meaning aimed at, or of any connected meaning). .²2 Inapplicability, not being applicable. .²3 Inconclusive reasoning; absence of reasonable grounds (युक्त्यभाव); .²4 Penury, adversity.
